files.source:
package main

import "fmt"
import api "example.org/reexports/api"
import impl "example.org/reexports/impl"

use api::Count as Counter;

func main() {
    Counter++
    fmt.Println(api.Label, Counter, api.Count, &Counter == &impl.Count)
    total, count := api.Add(api.identity!(40), 1, 1)
    fmt.Println(total, count, api.Box[int]{Value: 7}.Get())
}

package main

import hgoUseRoute0 "example.org/reexports/api"
import hgoUseRoute1 "example.org/reexports/impl"

import "fmt"
import _ "example.org/reexports/api"
import impl "example.org/reexports/impl"

func main() {
	hgoUseRoute1.Count++
	fmt.Println(hgoUseRoute0.Label, hgoUseRoute1.Count, hgoUseRoute1.Count, &hgoUseRoute1.Count == &impl.Count)
	total, count := hgoUseRoute1.Add((40), 1, 1)
	fmt.Println(total, count, hgoUseRoute0.Box[int]{Value: 7}.Get())
}
